source_policy.use: Use TikTok watch/running search structures, visible high-attention hook mechanics, and watch-topic pain points as inspiration only.
source_policy.do_not_use: Do not copy exact creator wording, full captions, faces, videos, brand claims, or product-review conclusions.
source_policy.public_copy_rule: Generated RunWatchLab copy must be original, watch-specific, runner-specific, and not sound like affiliate watch content.
source_policy.hook_rule: Prefer 6-12 word hooks when the extra words preserve the TikTok question, contradiction, number, or runner pain point. Do not shorten so far that the source mechanic turns into a generic label. Use structure only, never verbatim creator wording.
source_policy.buying_advice_rule: Buying hooks are allowed as format ideas, but production scripts must not make current model recommendations without separate up-to-date product research.
